description: Office of the Governor - Uva Province - Order to appoint members to the Uva Provincial Counseling Committee, Road Passenger Transport Service Authority, etc.
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (specific named individuals being appointed to various positions on the Uva Province Counseling Committee on Early Childhood Development) with basic titles only (e.g., "Chairperson," "Member"). There are no detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making this a pure People Gazette.
